analysis.summary: DTD tests interactive debuggers, which can misretrieve or misinterpret program state and so mislead developers, and for which no scalable comprehensive correctness measurement existed. The authors propose testing criteria covering comprehensiveness of debug information and scalability, then build a differential framework that runs the same C executable through two mainstream debuggers and treats discrepancies as bugs. DTD found 13 bugs in the LLVM toolchain and 5 in the GNU toolchain.
